# Third-Party Notices

This distribution includes the production dependency closure recorded in `web/package-lock.json`.
Each license and notice file under `licenses/` is copied byte-for-byte from the pinned package, or is explicitly identified below as a supplemental canonical text. `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.json` records the package version, lockfile path, registry URL, integrity, source file, and SHA-256 mapping for every text.

## Project license

JsonCrack Preview for Neovim is licensed under MIT. The project license text is included at `LICENSE` in the source checkout and copied into the distribution license files.

## Embedded Reaflow ELK worker

The emitted asset is derived from Reaflow 5.4.1 and includes an ELK worker whose original bytes match `elkjs@0.10.0/lib/elk-worker.min.js` (Git blob SHA-1 `aefee8891cabdaf247410197304c1e4bee3cdb14`, SHA-256 `cda1839e26f82a7ac142692ee813974f8f359987348d21d1f16af8f86ff96e80`). Reaflow is licensed under Apache-2.0; the embedded worker carries EPL-2.0 attribution. The separately installed lockfile package is `elkjs@0.10.2`; it is distinct from the embedded worker source version.

The worker source is available in the pinned [elkjs 0.10.0 source archive](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/archive/refs/tags/0.10.0.tar.gz) at commit `8a4fc2e11c1a184daa156cf563961bd860980c5f`. The generated worker is based on the corresponding [Eclipse ELK 0.10.0 source archive](https://github.com/eclipse-elk/elk/archive/refs/tags/v0.10.0.tar.gz) at commit `30035c605c0d45467f673f7b6b263d44dc2632da`. These references identify the source; the EPL-2.0 text is included with this distribution.

License text files for this asset: `licenses/c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4.txt`, `licenses/611d02c48bb1709980dc43d5a114090045f1c953393875779042f745084269c4.txt`.
